title: Airline-card booking (the PCI path)
caption: checkout.createPayment {method: airline_card} → updatePayment (card fee) → completeWithAirlineCard, storefront edge only (ota/docs/flows/checkout-airline-card.md, src/payments/airline-card). The card exists only in memory as a SensitiveCard for the length of one request; only brand, BIN and last 4 are ever stored.

steps.label: checkout pricing_mode = net (no markup, no OTA fees); payments (provider airline, method airline_card)
steps.note: Refused 403 FEATURE_DISABLED when AIRLINE_CARD_ENABLED is false, airline_card_enabled_<env> is off or the method is suspended.

steps.label: totals with the airline's card fee (payments.card_fee_amount, card_fee_lines)
POST /api/v1/checkouts/{id}/airline-card-completion {card: number, securityCode, holder, expiry} + CSRF + Idempotency-Key
rl:ota_airline_card_ip (5/min), rl:ota_airline_card_tenant (60/h), t:…:ac:chk:<chk> (3 per checkout), t:…:ac:suspended
Luhn, expiry, brand ∈ accepted_card_brands; wrap in SensitiveCard (toJSON = "[redacted card]")
T1 idempotency (hash without the card), lock checkout, booking pending
limits checked again (beforeSend); payment processing with card_brand, card_bin, card_last4
Flight Create Orders issue=true, formOfPayments.creditCard (60 s)
order + tickets
steps.note: Declined: booking failed, payment failed, 402 PAYMENT_DECLINED; 3rd decline 403 PAYMENT_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED; 20 declines/hour suspend the method for the tenant.

steps.label: T2 booking ticketed, payment captured (airline.charged) only when every ticket came back; otherwise payment stays processing, ticketing manual_review, 201 with warning TICKETING_MANUAL_REVIEW
201 CheckoutCompletion (Set-Cookie __Host-vx_bt)
steps.note: No answer / 5xx: 504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT {bookingId}; the reconciler finds the order or hands the booking to staff (manual_review), never failed automatically.

steps.label: notify: booking.confirmed / booking.ticketed e-mails; document.render: itinerary + e-ticket receipts
